issues.on_page: Cash Basis Fund Balances - Ending 36,034,739 (p4); Cash and Cash Equivalents 35,538,398 + Investments 496,341 (p3)
issues.issue: ending_cash (and beginning_cash 29,636,223) is the cash-basis fund balance, which includes investments 496,341 that are also recorded in ending_investments; anyone adding the two counts 496,341 twice. Cash alone printed on p3 is 35,538,398. This is how the cash-basis convention works, but it should be checked.
Printed as Charges for Services in the KENO Fund column. The label supports the category, but the money is probably keno proceeds (keno/lottery). This is a judgment call and is left as printed.
